newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE fuel oil still rises while other products dip.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil still rises while other products dip.

text.p: NWE oil products all dipped on Thursday morning, except for fuel oil which continued its upward strides, dealers said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded in the range $116-$117 fob ARA, up $1 on Wednesday's close. The move did not reflect underlying demand which remained sluggish, traders said.

Heating oil barges dropped by $2 a tonne as futures weakened. Buyers were again thin on the ground. A public holiday in Germany took away many wholesalers, but many left still considered prices too high.
